jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - 1. Qualifizierungsphase (zur Promotion)
jobs.reason: The role requires a completed Master's in civil engineering, industrial engineering or a comparable field with expertise in building physics, sustainability and human-technology interaction — an essential the candidate's IR background plainly cannot meet. Although it is a funded doctoral position, the disciplinary requirement is a hard mismatch, and the building-physics subject sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.
jobs.type: Full-time (100%, part-time possible); 5-year fixed-term, funded PhD position

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in mit Daueraufgaben (PostDoc) (d/m/w)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD (Promotion) in computer science / information systems, which the candidate does not hold, plus deep technical expertise in distributed systems, software engineering, data management and security engineering. Both the doctorate prerequisite and the heavy technical requirements are unmet essentials, making this a clear hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Jurist:in / Referent:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: Requires a Volljurist:in (Befähigung zum Richteramt) — full German legal qualification with both state exams — which the candidate does not hold. This is an essential the candidate fails, and the personnel-law focus is outside the core interest zones regardless.

jobs.title: Jugendbildungsreferent*in (d/w/m) für die DGB-Region Südwestfalen
jobs.reason: Requires at least 3 years of relevant professional experience plus additional training, which the candidate lacks — a hard experience disqualifier. The role is union youth-education work with campaign and events focus, well outside the candidate's interest zones and skills.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) – Cyber-Physical Systems in Mechanical Engineering
jobs.reason: The essential requirements demand a Master's in engineering / applied mathematics / machine learning plus proven deep-technical ML experience (CNN, LSTM, Transformer, Autoencoder architectures, PyTorch/JAX, explainable AI) that the candidate's analysis-level Python cannot meet. This is a deep-technical ML research role in turbomachinery, entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.
jobs.type: Full-time (100%, part-time possible; fixed term to 31.08.2028)

jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche Museumsassistenz in Fortbildung (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: An essential requirement is a completed Master's in art history (Kunstgeschichte) or a closely related field plus specialist knowledge of 20th-century/contemporary art — a subject specialism the candidate plainly lacks. The role is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones (art-museum curation), making it both ineligible on the qualification and a poor topical fit.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in im Sektorvorhaben Flucht
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum), which is excluded by policy as not a genuine paid role for the candidate; it further requires current enrolment or graduation within the past 6 months. Although the development-cooperation and forced-displacement subject is of some interest, the internship status is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Bibliotheksmitarbeiter:in (w/d/m) – Periodika - Katalogisierung und Abonnementsverwaltung
jobs.reason: The role requires a completed vocational training as Fachangestellte für Medien- und Informationsdienste or equivalent library-specific skills (RDA cataloguing, Pica, journal databases) that the candidate does not hold — an unmet essential. It is a specialised library-technician post entirely outside the candidate's research and policy interests.
